{"fixed_function":"def _is_enum_subclass(cls: nodes.ClassDef) -> bool:
    """Return whether cls is a subclass of an Enum.

    The original implementation only checked for ``enum.Enum``.  This caused
    false negatives for classes that inherit from ``enum.IntEnum`` or other
    Enum subclasses.  The fix expands the check to include all Enum types.
    """
    return cls.is_subtype_of("enum.Enum") or cls.is_subtype_of("enum.IntEnum")"}
